newsitem.title: USA: Court denies Coastal Petroleum petition.
newsitem.headline: Court denies Coastal Petroleum petition.

text.p: Coastal Petroleum Co said Florida's First District Court of Appeal Monday refused to issue a writ of certiorari in the company's ongoing battle with the Department of Environmental Protection over the issuance of an offshore drilling permit.

A Coastal spokesman said the court ruling does not address other remedies sought by the company -- such as directing the agency to issue a permit without further delay -- and that the company is considering its options.
Coastal is seeking to commence drilling operations on its 800,000-acre offshore leasehold, which parallels the Gulf Coast from Apalachicola Bay to Naples.
It is a majority-held subsidiary of Coastal Caribbean Oils & Minerals Ltd. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
